detail.longDescription: Beware the entitled opportunist. Our culture encourages us to believe that the more we have, the more we deserve. The rules that apply to others don’t apply to us. Curious how this study is treated as a bit of a laugh. Its findings have been demonstrated by research in many settings (including as a 🚩 for sexual assault). The patterns it reveals are played out daily before our eyes in politics & plunder. And yet it’s a joke. # entitlement # opportunism # inequality # power # research # NothingToSeeHere # impunity # haha https://www. theguardian.com/science/2026/s ep/03/ig-nobel-prize-awards-2026-winners?CMP=Share_iOSApp_Other
